_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Göteborg C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). A ground-level terminus: tracks 1–16 and the hall; the upper level is the walkway to Nils Ericson Terminalen. Tram and bus stops (A–D) are left out.
